title: polystichum dissectum
intro: Polystichum dissectum, commonly known as the Japanese holly fern, is a type of evergreen fern native to Japan. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation and reduce stress, and its health benefits include lowering blood pressure and improving respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Polystichum dissectum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
